segments.EZR.1.1-2: God moves King Cyrus to send out a proclamation
segments.EZR.1.3-4: Cyrus invites God’s people to go and build the temple
segments.EZR.1.5-6: Many people prepare to go and rebuild the temple
segments.EZR.1.7-8: Cyrus brings out the temple articles for Sheshbazzar
segments.EZR.2.1-2: Zerubbabel and others lead the exiles back to Judah
segments.EZR.2.3-6: The families of Parosh, Shephatiah, Arah and Pahath-moab
segments.EZR.2.7-10: The families of Elam, Zattu, Zaccai and Bani
segments.EZR.2.11-14: The families of Bebai, Azgad, Adonikam and Bigvai
segments.EZR.2.15-18: The families of Adin, Ater, Bezai and Jorah
segments.EZR.2.19-22: Hashum and Gibbar families; men of Bethlehem and Netophah
segments.EZR.2.23-26: Men of Anathoth, Kiriath-jearim, Ramah and other towns
segments.EZR.2.27-30: People of Michmash, Bethel, Ai, Nebo and Magbish
segments.EZR.2.31-33: People of Elam, Harim, Lod, Hadid and Ono
segments.EZR.2.36-39: The four families of priests who returned
segments.EZR.2.40-42: Levites, singers and gatekeepers who returned
segments.EZR.2.43-46: Temple servant families from Ziha to Hanan
segments.EZR.2.47-50: More temple servant families, from Giddel to Nephusim
segments.EZR.2.51-54: More temple servant families, from Bakbuk to Hatipha
segments.EZR.2.55-58: Families of Solomon’s servants; total of 392 servants
segments.EZR.2.59-60: Some families cannot prove Israelite descent
segments.EZR.2.61-63: Some priests cannot find family records and are excluded
segments.EZR.2.64-65: The whole group numbers 42,360, with servants and singers
segments.EZR.2.66-67: The returning exiles have 736 horses and other animals
segments.EZR.2.68-69: Family heads give gold, silver and garments for the temple
segments.EZR.2.70-70: Priests, Levites and other Israelites settle in towns
segments.EZR.3.1-2: Jeshua and Zerubbabel begin to build the altar
segments.EZR.3.3-5: The Israelites set up the altar and offer sacrifices
segments.EZR.3.8-9: Levites are appointed to supervise the temple work
segments.EZR.3.10-11: Priests and Levites praise God for the new foundation
segments.EZR.3.12-13: Older people weep while others shout for joy
segments.EZR.4.1-2: Enemies of Judah ask to join in building the temple
segments.EZR.4.3-3: Zerubbabel and Jeshua refuse help with the temple
segments.EZR.4.4-5: The people of the land discourage the Jews from building
segments.EZR.4.6-6: An accusation is made against Judah and Jerusalem
segments.EZR.4.7-8: Rehum and Shimshai write against Jerusalem to the king
segments.EZR.4.9-10: A letter comes from Rehum, Shimshai and other officials
segments.EZR.4.11-12: The letter says the Jews are rebuilding a wicked city
segments.EZR.4.13-13: The letter warns that the king will lose tax money
segments.EZR.4.14-16: The officials ask the king to search the old records
segments.EZR.4.17-19: Artaxerxes replies that a search found the city rebelled
segments.EZR.4.20-22: Artaxerxes orders the men to stop rebuilding the city
segments.EZR.4.23-24: The officials force the Jews to stop building the temple
segments.EZR.5.1-2: Haggai and Zechariah help the Jews begin building again
segments.EZR.5.3-5: Tattenai asks the Jews who authorized the building
segments.EZR.5.6-7: Tattenai writes a letter to King Darius
segments.EZR.5.8-10: Tattenai reports that the Jews are building the temple
segments.EZR.5.11-11: The elders say the Jews serve the God of heaven and earth
segments.EZR.5.12-13: The Jews explain the exile and Cyrus’s decree
segments.EZR.5.14-15: Cyrus returned the temple articles to Sheshbazzar
segments.EZR.5.16-16: Sheshbazzar laid the foundation and building continues
segments.EZR.5.17-17: Tattenai asks the king to search the records in Babylon
segments.EZR.6.1-2: Darius orders a search and a scroll is found
segments.EZR.6.3-5: Cyrus ordered the temple rebuilt and its articles returned
segments.EZR.6.6-7: Darius tells Tattenai to leave the temple work alone
segments.EZR.6.8-10: Darius orders that the Jews be given money and offerings
segments.EZR.6.19-20: The exiles keep the Passover and the Levites kill the lambs
segments.EZR.6.21-22: The Israelites eat the Passover and keep the Feast with joy
segments.EZR.7.1-5: Ezra’s family line goes back to Aaron the chief priest
segments.EZR.7.6-7: Ezra, a skilled scribe, goes up from Babylon to Jerusalem
segments.EZR.7.8-10: Ezra arrives in Jerusalem and gives himself to God’s Law
segments.EZR.7.11-13: Artaxerxes lets willing Israelites go to Jerusalem with Ezra
segments.EZR.7.14-16: Artaxerxes sends Ezra with silver and gold for God’s house
segments.EZR.7.17-18: Artaxerxes tells Ezra to buy offerings with the money
segments.EZR.7.19-20: Artaxerxes tells Ezra to deliver the articles to God’s house
segments.EZR.7.21-23: Artaxerxes orders the treasurers to give Ezra what he needs
segments.EZR.7.24-24: Artaxerxes forbids taxes on the temple workers
segments.EZR.7.25-26: Artaxerxes tells Ezra to appoint judges and teach the law
segments.EZR.8.1-3: The family heads who return with Ezra are listed
segments.EZR.8.4-7: More family heads and their men who return are listed
segments.EZR.8.8-11: The list of family heads and their men continues
segments.EZR.8.12-14: The list of the families who return with Ezra ends
segments.EZR.8.15-16: Ezra finds no Levites and calls for the leaders
segments.EZR.8.17-17: Ezra sends leaders to Iddo to ask for ministers
segments.EZR.8.18-20: Levites and temple servants come to Ezra
segments.EZR.8.24-25: Ezra sets apart twelve priests to carry the offering
segments.EZR.8.26-27: Ezra weighs out the silver, gold and articles to the priests
segments.EZR.8.28-30: Ezra tells the priests to guard the holy offerings
segments.EZR.8.31-31: The group leaves the Ahava Canal and God protects them
segments.EZR.8.32-32: Ezra and the people arrive in Jerusalem and rest
segments.EZR.8.33-34: The silver, gold and articles are weighed in God’s house
segments.EZR.8.35-36: The exiles offer sacrifices and give the king’s edicts
segments.EZR.9.1-2: Leaders tell Ezra that Israel has married foreign women
segments.EZR.9.3-4: Ezra tears his clothes and sits in horror
segments.EZR.9.5-6: Ezra kneels in prayer, ashamed of the people’s guilt
segments.EZR.9.7-7: Ezra says the people’s guilt has led to captivity
segments.EZR.9.8-9: Ezra says God has shown grace and given new life
segments.EZR.9.10-12: Ezra says Israel broke God’s commands about marriage
segments.EZR.9.13-14: Ezra fears God’s anger if people marry foreigners again
segments.EZR.9.15-15: Ezra says God is righteous and the people are guilty
segments.EZR.10.1-2: A large crowd weeps, and Shecaniah speaks of hope
segments.EZR.10.3-4: Shecaniah urges Ezra to act and send away foreign wives
segments.EZR.10.5-5: Ezra makes the leaders and all Israel take an oath
segments.EZR.10.6-6: Ezra mourns and fasts in Jehohanan’s room
segments.EZR.10.7-8: A call goes out for all the exiles to gather in Jerusalem
segments.EZR.10.9-10: Ezra accuses the men of Judah of unfaithful marriages
segments.EZR.10.11-11: Ezra tells the men to confess and leave foreign wives
segments.EZR.10.12-13: The assembly agrees but says the work needs more time
segments.EZR.10.14-15: The assembly asks leaders to handle the cases town by town
segments.EZR.10.16-17: Ezra and the family heads investigate the marriages
segments.EZR.10.18-19: Priests pledge to send away foreign wives and bring a ram
